item.irani_tuber.camera.tooltip.2: More friends nearby = more views and subs
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.1: Salam be hamegi! Khosh omadin be kanal-e ma!
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.2: Rafagha, like o subscribe yadetun nare ha!
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.3: Emruz ye video-ye khafan tu rahe, doorbin kojast?
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.5: Faghat ye video-ye dige, ghol midam!
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.6: In map ro bayad hatman tu video neshun bedam.
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.7: Inja nur ali-e, ye doorbin biar!
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.8: Thumbnail-e in video bayad ye chiz-e divoone-konande bashe.
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.9: Zangule ro bezan ke video-ye badi ro az dast nadi.
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.11: Ki miad baham ye clip begire?
dialogue.irani_tuber.idle.12: Ide-ye video-ye badi tu zehname, vali hanuz nemigam!
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.2: Are begu, che khabar? Video begirim?
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.3: Comment gozashti? Na? Khob hamin ja begu!
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.5: Bebin, ye doorbin biar ta ba ham ye video begirim.
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.6: Kheili khosh omadi, beshin ye chizi bokhor.
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.8: Age kanalemun roshd kone, ye video-ye vizhe barat misazam!
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.9: Hey rafigh, salam! Doorbin dastet bud migeretimesh.
dialogue.irani_tuber.interact.10: To behtarin hamtimi-ye Minecraft-i hasti, jeddi migam!
dialogue.irani_tuber.hurt.3: Cut! Cut! In sahne ro dobare migirim!
dialogue.irani_tuber.hurt.4: In yeki ro dige az video hazf mikonam!
dialogue.irani_tuber.hurt.6: Baba aroom-tar, man youtuberam na sang!
dialogue.irani_tuber.hurt.7: Hamin ro kam dashtam, deadline-e video!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_start.1: Doorbin roshane? Bashe, se, do, yek, shoroo!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_start.5: Ghashang begir, in ghesmat viral mishe!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_start.6: Bacheha, tu in video ye surprise darim!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_start.7: Ru-ye doorbin bekhandam ya jeddi bashm?
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_done.1: Ali shod! Video ro upload kon!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_done.3: Bebin che videoi shod, thumbnail ro besepar be man!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_done.4: Fekr konam in yeki kolli view mikhore!
dialogue.irani_tuber.camera_done.6: Khodaye man, in behtarin sahne-ye mah bud!
dialogue.irani_tuber.catch.1: Hamishe ba energy, hamishe ba labkhand!
dialogue.irani_tuber.catch.2: In yeki dige vaghean harf nadasht!
video.irani_tuber.title.1: Minecraft vali hame chiz dast-e ye youtuber-e!
video.irani_tuber.title.2: Ye shab tu ghar, bedun-e hich naghshe-i
video.irani_tuber.title.4: Man o dustam ye rustaa sakhtim
video.irani_tuber.title.5: Chalesh-e baghaa ba faghat ye tir o kaman
video.irani_tuber.title.8: Ye ruz-e kamel ba dustam tu Minecraft
message.irani_tuber.rec_start: ● Recording... keep the camera in your hand!
